evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.limitation: The scenario definition for 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' (roster composition, champion, level, item set, fight window, damage-type split) is NOT present anywhere under data/ or docs/math-foundations.md — it lives in scripts/, which this runbook forbids. The oracle therefore cannot re-simulate the fight end-to-end; it verifies the DELTA against the sourced item rules instead.

sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
rules_extracted: applies ONLY to magic damage ('increased magic damage')
applies only to ENEMY CHAMPIONS of the holder (not the holder's own team, not non-champions)
aura gated at 700 units from the holder
credited 'from all sources' (allies of the holder benefit)

sources_quoted.quote: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
rules_extracted: applies to ALL damage types ('from all sources')
requires an immobilize on an enemy champion; window 4 s, refreshed by re-immobilize

sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|magic damage}} to an enemy champion with a [[champion ability]] applies a stack of ''Vile Decay'' to them for 6 seconds, stacking up to 4 times and up to once per basic attack or ability per {{tip|cast instance}} every {{fd|0.3}} seconds. Each stack inflicts {{as|{{fd|7.5}}% magic resistance reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|mr}} at 4 stacks.
rules_extracted: this is a RESISTANCE REDUCTION (7.5%/stack, max 30%), not a damage amplifier
it composes at the mitigation step, not as a damage multiplier

sources_quoted.quote: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R)          (apply_resistance, resistance.py) ... post = raw . m(R)
sources_quoted.use: mitigation identity used to test the 'Vile Decay MR-reduction' explanation of the delta

sources_quoted.quote: R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat).(1 - r_pct/100).(1 - p) - f)
sources_quoted.use: percentage MR reduction multiplies the running resistance; it changes damage by the ratio (100+R)/(100+0.7R) on the MAGIC component only

sources_quoted.quote: f(S) = the coupled participant-timeline score: deterministic total damage dealt by the main participant before its own death
sources_quoted.use: fixes the meaning of the leaf 'focus_damage_before_death': cumulative damage the main participant deals to the focused enemy up to its own death

sources_quoted.quote: (the table audits mitigation, penetration, stat growth, AS, AH, auto counting, crit expectation, rotations, DoT/stacking DoT, on-hit stacking, phantom hits, burn, grievous wounds, shields, grey health, revive, BIS score, stat rounding, Terminus/BC ramps)
sources_quoted.use: NO row audits damage AMPLIFIERS (Vulnerable / curse-style 'increased damage taken'). The amplifier family was never pinned by the P2 audit, so it is the family most likely to still carry an unsourced over-application.

step_1_the_change_is_not_a_whole-leaf_fa.test: compare old/new against every whole-total factor the three items can produce
step_1_the_change_is_not_a_whole-leaf_fa.conclusion: old/new = 1.10189 matches NO clean whole-total amplifier factor. The change therefore acted on a PROPER SUBSET of the leaf's damage - exactly the signature of a damage-type-gated or target-gated amplifier.

step_2_attribute_the_delta_to_an_amplifi.identity: if an amplifier of magnitude a was withdrawn from a component C of the damage, then delta = a * C and C <= new_total

a=0.07 (Imperial Mandate 'Vulnerable', S.why: the implied component (3178.6) exceeds the entire new leaf total (2183.7); no sub-component of the damage can be that large, so the delta CANNOT be the 7% Vulnerable amp being turned on/off over the whole fight

a=0.1984 / 0.19 (both amps together).note: arithmetically admissible but requires both amps to move at once on ~52% of the damage

step_2_attribute_the_delta_to_an_amplifi.conclusion: The delta is exactly 12% of an 1854.17-damage component. 12% is the Abyssal Mask curse (S1) and nothing else in the scenario's named items produces 12%. The Imperial Mandate 7% amp is arithmetically excluded as the sole mover.

reading_A_curse_withdrawn_entirely.means: the old value applied the curse (magic-only, correctly typed); the new value applies no curse at all

reading_B_curse_narrowed_to_magic_damage.model: old = 1.12 x 2148.39 (curse applied to ALL damage) = 2406.2 ; new = 1.12 x magic 294.23 + physical 1854.17 = 2183.7
reading_B_curse_narrowed_to_magic_damage.means: the old value amplified the whole mixed-damage total by 12%; the new value amplifies only the magic component, per S1's wording 'increased MAGIC damage'

step_3_two_self-consistent_readings_of_t.arithmetic_status: both reproduce 2406.2 and 2183.7 exactly; they are distinguished only by the scenario's magic/physical split, which is not visible from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md
step_3_two_self-consistent_readings_of_t.rejected_reading_C_vile_decay_ramp: a Bloodletter's Curse 30% MR-reduction toggle would scale the MAGIC component by (100+R)/(100+0.7R) (S4, S5). For any integer target MR this ratio is 1.053 (R=20) to 1.212 (R=140) and never equals 1.10189 on a pure-magic total (integer-MR steps move the ratio by 0.5-0.9%, far outside the +/-0.005% rounding band), so it only fits by tuning a free magic-share parameter; it is not excluded, but it is not indicated either.

step_4_which_side_the_sourced_text_suppo: S1 states three narrowing conditions on the curse: magic damage only, enemy CHAMPIONS of the holder only, and a 700-unit aura. Every one of them cuts the amplifier's domain DOWNWARD relative to a naive 'target has Abyssal Mask nearby -> multiply the fight total by 1.12' implementation.
S2's 7% amp is arithmetically excluded as the mover (step 2), so the change is not a Vulnerable-window or immobilize-gating change.
S3's Vile Decay is a resistance reduction, not an amplifier, and composes at the mitigation step (S5); it cannot produce a type-gated 12% delta.
S7: the P2 formula audit pinned every other family but never audited damage amplifiers, so an unsourced amplifier over-application is precisely the residue this corpus scenario would surface.

Direction: the new value is LOWER by exactly one 12% amplifier applied to a sub-component. The sourced text of S1 supports a narrowed (magic-only / holder's-enemies-only) application; it contains no clause that would justify BROADENING the amplifier, i.e. nothing in the wiki cache supports the higher old value over the lower new value.
Repo failure-mode prior (CLAUDE.md rule 5, the 3x Statikk Shiv overstatement): corrections in this engine have historically removed unsourced overstatement.
independent_computation.residual_uncertainty: If the scenario's focus damage is ~85% magic (reading A), the change removed the curse outright and 2406.2 would be the sourced value instead. The single discriminating fact needed is the magic/physical split of 'focus_damage_before_death' in this scenario: magic share ~0.849 => reading A (old correct); magic share ~0.137 => reading B (new correct). That split is not derivable from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md under this runbook's read restrictions.

verdict_rationale: The delta is exactly a 12% amplifier withdrawn from a proper sub-component of the leaf - the signature of Abyssal Mask's 'Unmake' being restricted, not of any other effect in the scenario (the 7% Vulnerable amp is arithmetically impossible as the mover, and Vile Decay is a resistance reduction, not an amplifier). Abyssal Mask's cached wiki text narrows the amplifier on three axes (magic damage only, enemy champions of the holder, 700-unit aura); all three cut downward, and no cached text supports applying 12% beyond the magic component. The lower new value is the one consistent with the sourced effect text, so: new_value_correct.
